noWorkspace.title: No workspace to open.
noWorkspace.body: The IDE reads the working tree of a thread. Start or open a thread, then return here.

noFile.title: No file is open.
noFile.body: Choose a file in the tree, or search the workspace. Diffs work without opening the editor first.

file.tooLarge: This file is too large for the editor.
file.leftToTerminal: h4rn leaves this file to a terminal or your full IDE.
file.deletedOnDisk: This file was deleted on disk.
file.changedOnDisk: This file changed on disk while you were editing.

bar.handToAgentHint: Start a thread with this file in context

search.title: Search
search.label: Search files
search.intro: Type a pattern, then Enter. Results stream in as the daemon walks the tree.

save.closeBody: This tab has changes the daemon has not accepted yet. Closing it without saving discards them.

conflict.deletedBody: This file was removed after you opened it. Recreate it with your version, leave it deleted, or cancel and keep editing.
conflict.changedBody: Someone else saved this file after you opened it. Keep your version, take theirs, or cancel and keep editing.

diff.label: Diff
diff.listFailed: The file list did not load.
diff.openFile: Open a file to compare it.
diff.tooLarge: This file is too large to diff. Open it in your editor or a terminal instead.
diff.binary: Both sides are binary, so there is no text diff to show.
diff.sinceHint: Commits are listed since the merge base with {{base}}.
diff.refreshHint: Read the branch and commit lists again
diff.refreshLabel: Refresh the branch and commit lists

files.label: Changed files
files.truncated_one: The list stops at {{count, number}} file. Review the rest from a terminal.
files.truncated_other: The list stops at {{count, number}} files. Review the rest from a terminal.

comments.sendHint: Adds these comments to the thread’s composer draft. Nothing sends until you press Send.
comments.placeholder: What should the agent change here?
comments.elsewhere_one: {{count, number}} comment belongs to another diff source, so it is listed here with the source each was written in.
comments.elsewhere_other: {{count, number}} comments belong to another diff source, so they are listed here with the source each was written in.
comments.hidden_one: {{count, number}} comment is on lines hidden by collapsed context.
comments.hidden_other: {{count, number}} comments are on lines hidden by collapsed context.
comments.added_one: {{count, number}} review comment added to the draft
comments.added_other: {{count, number}} review comments added to the draft
comments.addedBody: They send when you press Send in the composer.
